name: COMP_021
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
Slide-level prediction is Benign, but right-half regions score high for risk and superior margin is flagged [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, InSitu 3%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Strong slide-level Benign probability |
| Conformal set | Benign (90% coverage target; dataset coverage 90%) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 88th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC; moderately atypical embedding |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models match top class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%), 3/5 InSitu [F5] | Majority of neighbors are InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasive score (-0.944), but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 10) · context · Above-typical immune context score (-0.498); 8/20 AI spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 4) · ↓ invasive · Supports non-invasive read (-0.26); 20/20 AI spot check [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 6, 11) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable pro-invasive score (+0.256); 0/20 AI spot check, weak concept · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 10) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable pro-invasive score (+0.176); 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (0.0114; 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal lobules, mitoses, and necrosis scores.

## Could be wrong if
- Right-half regions 11 (95%), 2 (88%), 7 (74%), and 6 (56%) harbor focal carcinoma diluted across the slide.
- The lesion represents InSitu disease (like 3/5 neighbors, including BACH_0163 at 87% similarity) or involves the superior margin.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 11, 2, 7, 6**: Inspect high-risk right-half areas (risks 95%, 88%, 74%, 56%) for in situ or invasive carcinoma.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 0**: Examine the superior margin (108 um involved strip) flagged for tumor at margin.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Verify benign stroma and lobules manually, since the normal-lobule concept is unreliable (0/20).
